correctness.rationale: The induced return-time model gives the positive pressure root sum_{k>=0}exp(-beta A_k-P(k+1))=1, including the zero-marker fixed measure (pressure 0). With b=exp(-beta c zeta(p)), split the excess over the geometric tail into k=0, k=1, k>=2 and a long tail k>=beta^a with a>1/(p-1). For 1<p<2 the long-tail Mellin sum is c Gamma(2-p)/(p-1)*beta*b^(p-1); the k=1 term is exp(-beta*c*(1+2^-p)). The remaining k>=2, denominator expansion O(R^2+b), and cut-off middle terms are lower order than the smaller competing exponent. For p>=2 the tail is lower order than k=1. Gamma stochastic ordering proves (p-1)zeta(p) strictly increases and meets 1+2^-p once. At equality the beta prefactor determines the winner. Verified numerical critical root p*=1.553201524280211. No uniformity for varying c or p claimed.
